assumptions: USB VBUS spans 4.75-5.25 V as used by the provided component-selection rationale.
Both I2C lines may be low simultaneously for conservative rail-current and resistor checks.
The ESP32 500 mA RF-TX figure and TMP102 10 uA figure are used as supplied; other 3.3 V loads are absent.
The 600 mA continuous figure is treated as the rail-design requirement even though the closed-form listed load is about 501.45 mA.
No LED or divider network is present in the declared design, so no LED or divider tests are reported.
NCP1117 stability with the selected ceramic output capacitor cannot be verified from the supplied data because ESR/stability limits are not provided.
USB source-current entitlement and LDO thermal safety remain unverified and must not be inferred from connector or electrical current ratings alone.
This is closed-form steady-state analysis only; startup, transient, RF-burst droop, PCB copper temperature rise, and SPICE behavior are excluded.
models: VOUT margin: compare NCP1117 limits 3.255-3.345 V with load supply ranges and the +/-5% rail window.
